name: Ben & Jerry's
notes: All 3 photos are printed menu boards for this Ben & Jerry's, photographed at different times with different prices (older and newer price sheets); used photo 1 as the primary source since it shows Cups & Cones, Sundaes, Shakes and Smoothies together most completely. The long list of ice cream flavor names (Today's Flavors / Flavor List) has no prices and was treated as a flavor catalog rather than individual menu dishes, so it was omitted; add-on items (add a waffle cone, add a dipped waffle cone) were skipped as modifiers.
